title: Mac at Any Scale: Workarounds for macOS Data-Center CI
summary: Namespace published “Mac at Any Scale,” a practitioner account of the engineering needed to run Macs at data-center scale, particularly for macOS CI and testing. The article focuses on workarounds for Apple platform limitations rather than a new Apple server product or a measured performance breakthrough. The supplied comments add operational detail but do not independently verify the article’s specific implementations.
